source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defining and calling functions (PDF 46).

blocks.text: Function def keyword se banaya jata hai: pehle def, phir function ka naam aur brackets ( ), jin mein parameters (function ko milne wali values ke naam) ho sakte hain. Function ki body (andar ka code) indented honi zaroori hai.

def function_name(parameters):
    # code to be executed
Misaal: kisi insaan ko salaam karne wala function banayein.

def greet(name):
    print("As-Salaam-Alaikum", name)
# Function invoking means call the function by name and perform the required task For example.
greet ('Ali')

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab greet (‘AH’) wali line function ke andar (indented) chhapti hai; aise yeh call kabhi nahi chalti aur program kuch print nahi karta. Call function ke baad, baen margin se likhi jati hai. Naam bhi 'AH' chhapa hai jabke wazahat 'Ali' kehti hai, aur quotes seedhe (' ') hone chahiyein: greet('Ali').

Wazahat: greet function ek parameter name leta hai. greet('Ali') bulane (invoke karne) par name ki value 'Ali' hoti hai aur output "As-Salaam-Alaikum Ali" aata hai. Function invoke karne ka matlab hai us ke naam se usay bulana ta ke woh apna kaam kare.

blocks.prompt: Python mein function banane ke liye kaunsa keyword hai (MCQ 8)?

items: Function ko naam se bulayein: greet('Ali').
